description: CloudLPS is described as proprietary cloud software for liquid-pipeline simulation. Its technical article covers steady transport, water hammer, alternating hot and cold oil, visual control logic and energy-use optimisation. The provider is PipeChina and CloudLPS development authors. Coverage: The reported applications concern Chinese pipeline systems. Exact general model-size limits, time steps and current service availability are not stated in the abstract. Access: The journal provides a public bilingual article describing the tool. No cloud account or software access was requested. Licence and cost: The article explicitly describes independent proprietary rights. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): proprietary (the describing article, itself CC-BY-3.0, states that the software carries independent proprietary rights). Limitations: The authors compare calculations with SPS, TLNET and field data. Those reported comparisons were not independently reproduced. For simulation it is a candidate tool for hydraulic, thermal and operating-control studies of liquid transport. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
